gaps: Rohdaten / Linienanalyse / Datenqualitätsindex evaluation types have no 'Anzeigen' action and no report view exists, so their read-a-report flow could not be judged at all.
view-chart-connection and view-chart-fa (the full-page chart views) were never opened directly — chart behaviour is only known from the V11 popup.
view-raw-connection was not exercised; it is assumed to behave like view-raw-punct but that was not verified interactively.
No loading state was ever observed: reports render instantly from in-page data, so it is unknown what the user sees while a real evaluation is fetched.
No error or empty-result state was reachable in this flow, so recovery from a failed or zero-row report is unknown.

findings.finding: The Pünktlichkeit report's breakdown selects change nothing: the option-disabling cascade reacts, but the table below is re-rendered byte-identical no matter which dimension is chosen.
findings.user_impact: The analyst's core step — breaking the quality figures down by stop, TU or operating day — silently fails, and because the control visibly reacts the analyst is likely to believe the data really is identical across every dimension rather than suspect a bug.
findings.suggested_fix: Make renderPunctReport() read the three select values and regroup the rows (including the first column header) instead of always rendering PUNCT_DATA.bundles.

evidence.action: Real Chromium (Playwright, /usr/bin/chromium-browser): logged in, opened the first 'Pünktlichkeit' evaluation via its 'Anzeigen' button, captured a table signature, then set #punct-auf-1 to 'Linienbündel' and #punct-auf-2 to 'Line' and re-captured after each change.
evidence.observed: All three captures are identical — 26 rows / 20 visible, first bundle row 'AAGL BusÜ 1 | 14.048 | 13.954 | 13.106 | 94 | 93,92%', first column header 'Name / Line bundle'. Distinct from AUTO-6: these selects are #punct-auf-* and DO carry onchange="punctCascade()", but punctCascade() only toggles option.disabled before calling renderPunctReport(), which ignores the select values entirely. The re-render also silently collapses any expanded bundle.

findings.element: Pünktlichkeit report (V11) — bundle row expander caret (.punct-expand-btn) on each Linienbündel row
findings.finding: The first click on a bundle's expand caret does nothing, and the caret icon never changes, so the control gives no signal that it works or which state a row is in.
findings.user_impact: An analyst drilling from a bundle down to its lines clicks once, sees nothing happen, and concludes the row has no detail — the drill-down step of the primary task is abandoned before the second click that would actually have worked.
findings.suggested_fix: Ship the expander with the .collapsed class already set (matching the .punct-hidden line rows) and swap the icon between expand_more and expand_less on toggle.

evidence.action: Real Chromium: opened the Pünktlichkeit report from a fresh load and clicked the first bundle caret three times in a row, counting visible #punct-tbody rows and reading the icon text + class after each click.
evidence.observed: init 20 visible, icon 'expand_more', class 'punct-expand-btn' → click 1: still 20 visible (nothing happens), class becomes '…collapsed' → click 2: 26 visible (6 line rows appear) → click 3: back to 20. The icon reads 'expand_more' in all four states. Matches the state map's 4× reproduction.

findings.element: Anschlusspünktlichkeit report (V5) — expandable param chips '15 TU's ▾', '8 Kantone ▾', '42 Linien ▾' in the header row
findings.finding: The expandable param chips carry every affordance of an editable multi-select filter — a caret, a pointer cursor, an opening dropdown of TU names — but the list is read-only, the items are unclickable, and there is no Apply anywhere in the report.
findings.user_impact: An analyst who reads the figures and wants to narrow to one TU or canton opens the chip, finds nothing selectable and no way to commit, and has to abandon the report and rebuild the whole evaluation from the wizard to change a single parameter.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the chip contents as plain read-only text (no caret, no pointer cursor) and put an explicit 'Parameter ändern' action on the report that reopens the evaluation in the wizard.

evidence.action: Real Chromium: opened the 'Anschlusspünktlichkeit – Letzte 30 Tage' evaluation, clicked the '15 TU's' chip, then inspected the computed cursor and onclick of the chip, its dropdown items, and searched the whole view for an Apply/Anwenden/Übernehmen button.
evidence.observed: The chip (.rpt-param-chip--partial) has cursor:pointer and an expand_more caret and opens .rpt-chip-dropdown listing AAGL, AAGR, AB, ABI, … Every .rpt-chip-dd-item has cursor:auto and onclick=false; 0 apply-type buttons are visible in the view; the only buttons on V5 are CSV Export, bar_chart, table_chart and expand_more. A second click collapses the panel.

findings.element: Pünktlichkeit report (V11) — the region between the page header and the breakdown selects, where V5 and V8 place their KPI cards
findings.finding: The Pünktlichkeit report has no KPI summary at all — it opens straight into the breakdown selects and a 20-row table — while the other two report types lead with headline cards and a stated threshold.
findings.user_impact: The 'read the quality figures' step has no answer at a glance on the most-used report type: the analyst must find the Gesamt row inside the table and compare 90,84% against a threshold that is never shown, where the same analyst on V5 is handed 'All day 89,53% ⚠ — Threshold: 90%' immediately.
findings.suggested_fix: Give V11 the same KPI card band as V5/V8 (Gesamt Wert, Soll/Ist volume, Delta) with the punctuality threshold labelled on the card.

evidence.action: Real Chromium: opened all three finished report types via their 'Anzeigen' buttons and counted elements matching [class*=kpi] inside each report view.
evidence.observed: view-report-punct: 0. view-report-connection: 17 (the 4 documented cards). view-report-fa: 25 (the 3 documented cards). V11's first content region is the 'Aufschlüsseln' select row; its only figures are inside the table, and no threshold appears anywhere on the page.

findings.element: All report/detail views — 'Schließen' / 'Close' button, and the sidebar while a report is open
findings.finding: The same 'leave this report' action is offered inconsistently: a Close button exists on the Pünktlichkeit report and the raw-data view but not on Anschlusspünktlichkeit, Fahrtausfälle or the Ausfallmaske, and no sidebar item is marked active anywhere inside a report.
findings.user_impact: An analyst who learns to close a report with the Close button finds it missing on the next report type and has to hunt for the breadcrumb instead, with a sidebar that shows no current location to fall back on — a small stall repeated on every report they open.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the Close button on all six report/detail views, and mark the 'Auswertungen' sidebar item active whenever any report view is open.
